veg.n: Miles's birthday caramel popcorn balls (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the balls up to 2 days ahead and keep airtight at room temperature

steps.text: Pop the kernels in the oil in a covered pot and tip into a big bowl, discarding unpopped kernels.
Melt the butter, vegetarian marshmallows and brown sugar over low heat, stirring until smooth, with a pinch of salt.
Pour over the popcorn and stir quickly to coat. Cool briefly.
With buttered hands squeeze into balls and roll in the sprinkles.
Set on baking paper until firm.

veg.n: Bowling night cheesy gravy chips (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the gravy up to 3 days ahead and reheat with a splash of water; bake the chips and assemble on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C, turning once, then toss with the vegetarian chicken salt.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce. Simmer until thick and glossy.
Pile the chips on a platter, scatter with cheddar and pour over the hot gravy.
Finish with chives.

veg.n: Uncle Buck's giant buttermilk pancake with smoked maple pecans
veg.make_ahead: Make the smoked maple pecans up to 3 days ahead, airtight; make the batter and cook the pancake just before serving

steps.text: Toast the pecans in a dry pan, add a tablespoon of the maple syrup and the smoked paprika and stir until sticky. Cool on baking paper and roughly chop.
Whisk the flour, sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk in the eggs, buttermilk and some melted butter until just combined.
Heat a large 28cm non-stick pan over low heat and grease with butter. Pour in all the batter and cover with a lid.
Cook until bubbles set on top.
Slide onto a plate, flip back in and cook the other side.
Top with butter, the rest of the maple syrup, banana and the smoked maple pecans.

veg.n: Lakeside crumbed haloumi bites with tartare
veg.make_ahead: Crumb the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled, and mix the tartare up to 2 days ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Pat the haloumi dry and cut into thick bite-size fingers.
Toss in flour, dip in egg, then coat in panko.
Shallow fry in the oil at 180C, turning once, until golden. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with the capers, pickles, parsley and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Lake cabin campfire s'mores (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Best built while the marshmallows are warm; lay out the biscuits and chocolate on the tray up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Lay half the biscuits on a lined tray. Top some with milk chocolate and the rest with dark chocolate and a little caramel.
Thread the vegetarian marshmallows onto skewers and toast over a fire or gas flame until golden, or grill on a tray.
Put the marshmallows on each chocolate biscuit and press another biscuit on top. Eat while warm.

veg.n: Boot camp crackers with pimento cheese (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

ingredients.item: roasted red capsicum from a jar, chopped

steps.text: Mix the cheddar with the mayonnaise, capsicum, soy sauce, cayenne and black pepper, keeping it a little chunky.
Chill so the flavours settle.
Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with crackers and celery sticks.

veg.n: Lighten up, Francis cocktail franks (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Mix the glaze up to 3 days ahead; score, fry and glaze the franks just before serving

steps.text: Score the vegetarian frankfurts diagonally a few times each.
Fry in the oil until the cuts open up and the outsides colour.
Add the tomato sauce, honey, American mustard and soy sauce and toss until sticky and glazed.
Serve on toothpicks with a pot of wholegrain mustard.

veg.n: Country club Bloody Mary hearts of palm cocktail
veg.make_ahead: Cut the hearts of palm and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; assemble in the glasses to serve

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400g each), drained

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and cut into thick coins. Toss with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, horseradish, soy sauce, hot sauce, celery salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Shred the lettuce into glasses and spoon over some sauce.
Pile the hearts of palm on top, spoon over more sauce, dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges and a celery stick.

veg.n: Beach kiosk battered tofu bites with lime aioli
veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu and mix the aioli up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Press the tofu between paper towels under a heavy board, then cut into bite-size pieces and toss with the crumbled nori.
Whisk the flour, cornflour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.
Dip the tofu and fry in the oil at 180C until crisp and golden, working in batches. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and lime zest and juice.
Sprinkle the tofu with sea salt and chilli flakes and serve with the aioli.

veg.n: Underhills' tab Bloody Mary (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, vodka, lemon juice and seasonings in a jug up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; rim the glasses and pour over ice to serve

steps.text: Mix the celery salt and pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of tall glasses with lemon and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Stir the tomato juice, vodka, juice of one lemon, horseradish, soy sauce and hot sauce in a jug.
Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge.

veg_af.make_ahead: Mix the tomato juice, pickle brine, lemon juice and seasonings in a jug up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; rim the glasses and pour over ice to serve

steps.text: Mix the celery salt and pepper on a saucer, wet the rims of tall glasses with lemon and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice.
Stir the tomato juice, pickle brine, juice of one lemon, horseradish, soy sauce and hot sauce in a jug.
Pour into the glasses and add a celery stick and a lemon wedge.

veg.n: Circle of trust mushroom croquetas
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled before frying

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a quarter of the butter until all the liquid has cooked off and they are golden.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in some of the flour for a couple of minutes, then slowly whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the mushrooms, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Spread on a tray, cover and chill.
Shape into small logs, roll in the remaining flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic and a squeeze of lime juice and serve for dipping.

veg.n: Coconut Grove corn and zucchini fritters
veg.make_ahead: Squeeze the zucchini and dice the capsicum up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; mix the dipping sauce up to 2 days ahead. Mix the batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Squeeze the grated zucchini hard in a clean tea towel to get rid of the water.
Mix the flour, egg, soda water, capsicum, spring onions, Cajun seasoning and salt into a thick batter, then fold in the corn and zucchini.
Drop heaped tablespoons into the oil at 180C and fry, turning, until golden. Drain.
Mix the mayonnaise, sweet chilli sauce and lime juice for the sauce.

veg.n: Peameal-style smoked tofu on a bun
veg.make_ahead: Brush the tofu with the soy and maple up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and mix the maple mustard up to 3 days ahead; crumb and fry on the night

steps.text: Cut the tofu into thick slices, brush with the soy sauce and a tablespoon of the maple syrup, then press both sides into the cornmeal.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Fry the onions in the same pan.
Mix the mustard with the rest of the maple syrup. Split and toast the buns, spread with maple mustard and fill with the tofu and onions.

veg.n: Dr Farthing's gambling debt buffalo jackfruit wings
veg.make_ahead: Drain, squeeze and pull the jackfruit up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; make the blue cheese dip up to 2 days ahead. Bake and toss on the night.

ingredients.item: tins (400g) young green jackfruit in brine

steps.text: Drain the jackfruit from the brine, rinse well and squeeze out as much water as you can.
Pull the jackfruit apart into shreds, discarding any tough core, then toss with the cornflour, olive oil and salt.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the jackfruit through it.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon. Serve the jackfruit hot with the dip and celery.

veg.n: Limo back seat smoky eggplant grissini
veg.make_ahead: Warm the olives with the orange zest, garlic and rosemary up to 3 days ahead and keep in the fridge; wrap the grissini with the eggplant on the day

steps.text: Pat the eggplant strips dry, dust lightly with smoked paprika and wrap each breadstick, spiralling around the top half.
Warm the olives in a small pan with the oil, orange zest, garlic and rosemary, then cool slightly.
Cube the cheddar.
Stand the grissini in a tall glass and serve with the olives and cheese.

veg.n: Rusty's diner gravy fries (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the stock gravy up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; bake the chips just before serving so they stay crisp

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C, turning once, and toss with the vegetarian chicken salt while hot.
Melt the butter in a small pan and cook the onion.
Stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer.
Strain into a jug. Serve the chips in a big basket with the gravy for pouring.

veg.n: Midnight mushroom pate on rye and buttermilk
veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom pate up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; build the sandwiches up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms, garlic and thyme in a third of the butter until dark and dry.
Blitz with the cream cheese, salt and pepper until smooth, then cool.
Spread the bread with the rest of the butter and a thin layer of mustard.
Spread the mushroom pate thickly over half the slices. Top with pickles and red onion, then the other slices.
Press down, trim the crusts and cut into fingers.
Pour the buttermilk into small glasses and serve together.

veg.n: Repo man Chicago-style hot dogs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Best built just before serving; dice the onion and cut the tomatoes up to 3 hours ahead, covered in the fridge

steps.text: Heat the vegetarian frankfurts in simmering water, then grill briefly for colour.
Steam or warm the buns and sprinkle the tops with poppy seeds.
Put a frankfurt in each bun, add mustard and relish, then onion, tomato, a pickle spear and pickled peppers.
Finish with a pinch of celery salt.

veg.n: Everybody's nice marshmallow cocoa (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Best made fresh; chop the chocolate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth and frothy.
Pour into heatproof mugs, pile the vegetarian marshmallows on top and put the mugs on a tray under a hot grill, watching closely, until puffed and golden.
Dust with cinnamon and serve.

veg.n: Caribbean cruise haloumi cocktail
veg.make_ahead: Mix the sauce up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; fry the haloumi and build the glasses just before serving

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and fry in a dry non-stick pan until golden on both sides. Cool slightly.
Mix the mayonnaise with the tomato sauce, juice of one lime, hot sauce and soy sauce.
Shred the lettuce into glasses and add cubes of avocado.
Spoon over the sauce and hang the haloumi around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.

veg.n: Last-minute Christmas Eve trifle (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: packet vegetarian raspberry jelly crystals (agar set)
mixed berries, plus a few extra to finish

steps.text: Make up the vegetarian jelly as the packet directs, bringing it to the boil so the agar dissolves.
Break the sponge into a large glass bowl and drizzle with orange juice. Scatter over the berries.
Pour the jelly over while still warm and chill until set.
Spoon the custard on top.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread over. Finish with almonds and a few berries.

veg.n: New York bodega bagel bites with beetroot lox
veg.make_ahead: Dress the beetroot and soak it up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and beat the cream cheese up to 1 day ahead; toast the bagels and build just before serving

steps.text: Toss the beetroot slices with the juice of one lemon, the olive oil, smoked paprika and a pinch of salt and leave to soak.
Split the bagels and toast until golden.
Beat the cream cheese with the chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half.
Top with folds of beetroot, capers, red onion and dill.
Finish with cracked pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.

veg.n: Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo cauliflower
veg.make_ahead: Make the ranch up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; batter, bake and sauce the cauliflower on the night so it stays crisp

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, baking powder, salt and half the garlic powder into a batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey, toss the cauliflower through and bake a few minutes more.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, buttermilk, chopped chives, chopped dill and the rest of the garlic powder for the ranch.
Serve with the ranch and carrot and celery sticks.

veg.n: Office party lentil, mushroom and onion rolls
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil and mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; roll, glaze and bake on the day

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Add the mushrooms and cook until all the liquid has gone, then cool.
Lightly mash the lentils and mix with the onion and mushroom, soy sauce, thyme, breadcrumbs, one egg and salt.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden. Serve with relish.

veg.n: Fezziwig's ball lentil, apple and sage rolls
veg.make_ahead: Cook the lentil and mushroom filling and roll the logs up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; glaze, cut and bake on the night

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and golden, then cool.
Lightly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, one egg, salt and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath.
Brush with the other egg and cut each into small rolls.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the mustard into the chutney and serve alongside.

veg.n: Aunt Dorothy's French onion dip (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Slowly cook the onions in the butter and oil over low heat until jammy and deep brown.
Add the soy sauce and a splash of water, scrape the pan, then cool.
Mix with the sour cream, cream cheese, most of the chives and salt.
Chill the dip.
Top with crispy shallots and chives and serve with kettle chips.

veg.n: Gertrude Lightstone's blinis with black lentil caviar
veg.make_ahead: Cook and dress the lentils up to 2 days ahead and chill; warm the blinis and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water until just tender, drain, then dress with the soy sauce and a few drops of lemon juice and cool.
Warm the blinis on a tray at 180C.
Mix the creme fraiche with the lemon zest and a pinch of salt. Crumble the smoked tofu into small flakes.
Top each blini with creme fraiche, a few flakes of tofu and a little spoon of the lentils.
Finish with chives and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.n: Phoenix street corn chipotle mushroom tacos
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the onion up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill the mushrooms and warm the tortillas on the night

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt and sugar.
Toss the mushrooms with the chipotle sauce, cumin and oil and grill on both sides until tender and charred.
Char the corn and cut off the kernels.
Mix the sour cream with lime juice. Warm the tortillas.
Fill with mushrooms, corn, feta, crema, onion and coriander.

veg.n: Covent Garden plant-based cevapi rolls with ajvar
veg.make_ahead: Mix and shape the plant-based cevapi up to 1 day ahead and chill until firm; brush with oil, grill and build the rolls on the night

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the garlic, paprika and salt and knead briefly.
Roll into short fingers and chill until firm.
Brush with the oil and grill over high heat, turning, until charred.
Split and toast the rolls and spread with ajvar.
Add cevapi to each and top with sour cream, onion and parsley.

veg.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Bake the pies with the vegetarian fruit mince up to 2 days ahead, airtight, and warm briefly in the oven; whip the brandy cream on the day

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with the vegetarian fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and the brandy.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

veg_af.n: Santa's shop mince pies with orange cream (vegetarian, alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Bake the pies with the vegetarian fruit mince up to 2 days ahead, airtight, and warm briefly in the oven; whip the orange juice cream on the day

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with the vegetarian fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar, the orange zest and a tablespoon of the orange juice.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the orange cream.

veg.n: Mary's grilled cheese and tomato soup (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the soup up to 3 days ahead and reheat gently; fill and fry the sandwiches just before serving

steps.text: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes, paprika, sugar and stock and simmer.
Blitz the soup smooth and stir in the cream.
Butter the outsides of the sourdough and fill with the cheddar and mozzarella.
Fry over medium heat until golden on both sides. Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.

veg.n: Boston trip mushroom and potato chowder
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently; stir in the cream on the night

steps.text: Melt the butter and fry the mushrooms over high heat until golden.
Add the smoked paprika, onion and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, kombu, potato and thyme and simmer until the potato is tender.
Lift out the kombu, stir in the cream and heat through. Season with salt and pepper and serve with the crackers.

veg.n: MORA command centre loaded potato skins (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Bake the potatoes and fry the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead, chilled; crisp, fill and top the skins on the night

steps.text: Prick the potatoes and bake at 200C until tender.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and brown.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter and salt.
Bake skin-side up, then flip.
Fill with cheddar and the crisp tofu and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream, spring onion and jalapenos, and drizzle with honey mixed with chilli flakes.

veg.n: Chicago Italian mushroom sliders
veg.make_ahead: Brown the mushrooms and simmer the jus up to 2 days ahead, chilled; reheat together and build to serve

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat until browned.
Simmer the stock with the garlic, oregano, chilli and soy sauce.
Drop the mushrooms into the jus to soak it up.
Split the buns and dip the cut sides quickly in the jus.
Pile in the mushrooms and top with pickled vegetables. Serve with little cups of jus for dunking.

veg.n: Sleigh ride salted caramel hot chocolate (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Heat and whisk on the night; the chocolate can be chopped ahead and the cream whipped up to 4 hours before

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and most of the caramel sauce until smooth.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel.
Add the vegetarian marshmallows and brown quickly with a kitchen torch or under the grill.

veg.n: Snow day toastie fingers with tomato soup (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Blitz the soup up to 3 days ahead and reheat; build the sandwiches up to 2 hours ahead and fry them fresh

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer, then blitz smooth and stir in the cream.
Spread the bread with mustard and make sandwiches with the smoked tofu and cheddar. Butter the outsides.
Fry until golden on both sides.
Cut into fingers and serve with cups of soup.

veg.n: Rinkside pretzel bun hot dogs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Caramelise the onions up to 2 days ahead and reheat; heat the frankfurts and warm the buns just before serving

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter until golden.
Heat the vegetarian frankfurts in simmering water, then grill briefly for colour.
Warm the buns in the oven.
Split the buns, add a frankfurt to each and top with onions, mustard, pickles and cheddar.

veg.n: Street party cranberry chilli meatballs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Roll the plant-based balls up to 1 day ahead and chill so they hold together; bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and salt.
Roll into small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C.
Simmer the cranberry sauce, sweet chilli, soy and lemon juice until glossy.
Toss the meatballs through, scatter with spring onion and serve on toothpicks.

veg.n: Cul-de-sac Christmas trifle (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: packet vegetarian strawberry jelly crystals (agar set)

steps.text: Make up the vegetarian jelly as the packet directs, bringing it to the boil so the agar dissolves, then cool a little.
Break the sponge into a glass bowl, drizzle with orange juice and add the berries. Pour over the jelly while still warm.
Chill until set.
Spoon over the custard.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar and spread on top. Scatter with honeycomb just before serving.

veg.n: St Bernadette's staffroom mince pies (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Fill and top the pies up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, then bake on the day; whip the cream just before serving

steps.text: Cut rounds from two pastry sheets and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill each with the vegetarian fruit mince. Cut stars from the third sheet and lay on top.
Brush with egg and bake at 190C until golden.
Whip the cream with some of the icing sugar and the orange zest.
Dust the warm pies with icing sugar and serve with the cream.

veg.n: Christmas fair lentil and apple rolls
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; roll, glaze and bake on the day

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and golden, then cool.
Lightly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, one egg and salt.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with the other egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden. Serve with relish.

veg.n: E.B.'s jellybean rocky road (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt the chocolate with the butter in a bowl over simmering water, then cool briefly.
Stir in the vegetarian marshmallows, most of the jellybeans, pretzels and coconut.
Spread into the tin and press more jellybeans on top.
Chill until set, then cut into squares with a hot knife.

veg.n: Sonny's sports bar barbecue cauliflower bites
veg.make_ahead: Mix the ranch up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; the batter does not hold, so batter, bake and sauce the cauliflower on the night

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, baking powder, paprika and salt into a batter and toss the cauliflower through it.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until golden.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey and hot sauce, toss the cauliflower through and bake again.
Mix the sour cream, mayonnaise, chives and garlic powder for the ranch.
Scatter the cauliflower with spring onion and serve with the ranch.

veg.n: Central Park everything bagel bites (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Mix the seasoning up to 1 week ahead; beat the cream cheese and crisp the tofu up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; toast the bagels and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Mix the seeds, onion flakes, garlic flakes and salt for the seasoning.
Beat the cream cheese with the spring onions until fluffy.
Crumble the smoked tofu and fry in the oil until crisp.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with the cream cheese, top with the crisp tofu and sprinkle with the seasoning.

veg.n: Blue jelly ice cream sundaes (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make and set the agar jelly up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cube it, whip the cream and build the sundaes on the night

ingredients.item: packet vegetarian blue jelly crystals (agar set)

steps.text: Make up the vegetarian jelly as the packet directs, bringing it to the boil, and pour into a shallow dish.
Set the jelly in the fridge, then cut into cubes.
Crush the biscuits into sand.
In tall glasses layer jelly cubes, ice cream and more jelly.
Top with whipped cream, biscuit sand, gummy lollies and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.

veg.n: Atlanta pimento cheese with crackers (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely grate the cheddar.
Mix with the mayonnaise, chopped capsicum, soy sauce, cayenne and black pepper until combined but still chunky.
Chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Spoon into a bowl, dust with paprika and serve with crackers, celery sticks and cornichons.

veg.n: Laura's chilli lime haloumi and avocado tostada bites
veg.make_ahead: Crisps and onion up to 1 day ahead, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Cut small rounds from the tortillas with a 6cm cutter and brush with oil. Bake at 200C until crisp, then cool.
Cut the haloumi into 16 small squares and fry in a dry non-stick pan until golden on both sides.
Toss the hot haloumi with lime juice and chilli flakes.
Mash the avocados with lime juice and salt.
Thinly slice the red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes.
Top each crisp with avocado, a piece of haloumi, a few onion slivers and a coriander leaf.

veg.n: Times Square halal cart spiced tofu skewers
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Press the tofu under a heavy board, then cut into cubes and toss with oil, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, coriander, crushed garlic and salt.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread the tofu onto skewers.
Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, vinegar, crushed garlic and a pinch of sugar into a white sauce.
Grill the skewers, turning, until golden and charred at the edges.
Warm the pita and shred the lettuce.
Serve the skewers on pita with white sauce, chilli sauce and lettuce.

veg.n: Ingrid's resolutions chocolate fondue (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Chocolate sauce up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Chop the chocolate and prepare the dippers on a platter.
Heat the cream until steaming.
Pour over the chocolate and leave to melt.
Stir until glossy, then stir in orange zest and a pinch of salt.
Keep warm in a fondue pot or a bowl over hot water.
Serve with strawberries, vegetarian marshmallows, brownie cubes and pretzels on skewers.

veg.n: Ploughman's board with apple chutney (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Chutney up to 1 week ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice one apple and the onion.
Simmer with brown sugar, cider vinegar and mixed spice until thick and sticky, then cool.
Slice the loaf and cut the cheddar into wedges.
Slice the remaining apples.
Arrange on a board with the artichoke hearts, pickled onions and chutney.

veg.n: Cornish beach hearts of palm and cress sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Pat the hearts of palm dry and shred with a fork. Mix with the nori, mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, cayenne and salt.
Butter the bread slices.
Spread the filling over half the slices, add thin cucumber slices and cress, then close.
Press gently, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into fingers.

veg.n: Cornish mushroom, cheddar and swede pasties
veg.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Finely dice the mushrooms, potato, swede and onion and mix with the cheddar, salt and pepper.
Cut rounds from the pastry sheets.
Spoon filling onto one half of each, add a small knob of butter, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with beaten egg and cut a small slit.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Serve with brown sauce.

veg.n: Admiral Benbow honey mustard sausages (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in a hot oven

steps.text: Cut each vegetarian sausage into three short pieces and toss with the oil.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C.
Mix the honey, wholegrain mustard and soy sauce.
Pour over the sausages, toss and roast until sticky and glazed.
Scatter with thyme leaves and serve on toothpicks.

veg.n: Memphis dry rub barbecue cauliflower bites
veg.make_ahead: Rub up to 1 day ahead, cook fresh

steps.text: Mix the paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne and salt.
Whisk the flour, water, baking powder and half the rub into a batter, coat the cauliflower and sprinkle with the rest of the rub.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Mix the barbecue sauce, mustard and vinegar for dipping.

veg.n: 98th percentile devilled eggs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the eggs in boiling water.
Cool in iced water, then peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
Mash with mayonnaise, mustard, chopped pickles and salt.
Pipe back into the whites.
Top the eggs with crispy shallots, a dusting of smoked paprika and chives.

veg.n: Nai Nai's pan-fried mushroom and tofu dumplings
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead, fill and fry fresh

steps.text: Finely chop the wombok, salt it and leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Finely chop the mushrooms, crumble the tofu and mix with the wombok, grated ginger, spring onions, most of the soy and the sesame oil.
Fill the dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Fry in the vegetable oil until golden underneath.
Add water, cover and steam until dry.
Mix the black vinegar, the rest of the soy and chilli oil for dipping.

veg.n: Valencia family mushroom and cabbage lumpia
veg.make_ahead: Roll up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a tablespoon of the oil until dry, add the cabbage for a minute, then cool.
Mix with grated carrot and onion, most of the garlic, spring onions, egg, soy and pepper.
Lay filling along the edge of each wrapper in a thin line and roll up tightly, sealing with water.
Fry in the rest of the oil at 180C until deep golden.
Mix the white vinegar with the remaining crushed garlic, chilli and pepper.
Serve with the vinegar and sweet chilli sauce.

veg.n: Easter party pancit with calamansi (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water, then drain.
Cut the tofu into strips and slice the mushrooms, onion, cabbage and carrot.
Stir-fry the tofu and mushrooms in oil until golden.
Add the onion, garlic, cabbage, carrot and snow peas.
Add the stock, soy and mushroom oyster sauce, then the noodles, and toss until absorbed.
Serve with lime or calamansi wedges and spring onion.

veg.n: Stone family vegetarian sausages in blankets
veg.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, roast fresh

steps.text: Cut the pastry into 20 long strips and wrap one around each vegetarian chipolata.
Lay on a lined tray and brush with egg.
Roast at 200C until the pastry is puffed and golden.
Brush with maple syrup for the last few minutes.
Mix the cranberry sauce with wholegrain mustard for dipping and serve hot on toothpicks.

veg.n: Georgia's hearts of palm cakes with lemon aioli
veg.make_ahead: Shape up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400g each), drained

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork and pat dry. Mix with the nori, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, egg, spring onions, lemon zest, Dijon and half the panko.
Shape into small cakes and chill for 30 minutes.
Roll in the rest of the panko.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden each side.
Mix the remaining mayonnaise with crushed garlic and lemon juice.
Serve with the aioli and a few dressed rocket and parsley leaves.

veg.n: Coorong garlic chilli mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Cook just before serving

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, such as Swiss brown and shiitake

steps.text: Tear or thickly slice the mushrooms.
Slice the garlic and chilli.
Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until golden.
Add the garlic and chilli and fry for a minute.
Add the stock, cover and steam briefly.
Stir in butter, lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with crusty bread.

veg.n: The headwaiter's famous tossed salad (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Dressing and croutons up to 1 day ahead, toss just before serving

steps.text: Tear the bread roll into chunks, toss with olive oil and crushed garlic.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Cook the eggs, then cool and halve.
Mash the capers and miso with garlic, then whisk in Dijon, lemon juice, mayonnaise and the cheese.
Tear the cos and butter lettuce into a big bowl.
Toss with the dressing and croutons and top with the eggs and more cheese.

veg.n: Charters Towers smoked tofu and pickle rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Split and butter the rolls.
Spread each base generously with mustard pickle.
Layer with thinly sliced smoked tofu, a slice of cheddar and a few leaves of iceberg lettuce.
Add thinly sliced tomato and a crack of pepper, close and cut in half.

veg.n: Nui Dat concert night tofu satay skewers
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Press the tofu under a heavy board, then cut into cubes and toss with chopped lemongrass, turmeric, garlic, 2 tbsp of the soy, half the brown sugar and the oil.
Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill, turning, until golden.
Simmer the peanut butter, coconut milk, the rest of the soy and brown sugar, chilli and lime juice into a satay sauce.
Serve with cucumber and lime wedges.

veg.n: Phuoc Tuy tofu rice paper rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered with damp paper towel

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water, then drain.
Cut the tofu into strips, fry in the oil until golden and toss with a tablespoon of the soy.
Julienne the carrot and cucumber.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time in warm water for a few seconds.
Lay tofu, noodles, vegetables, mint and coriander on each and roll tightly.
Mix the rest of the soy, lime juice, sugar, water, garlic and chilli for dipping.

veg.n: Fenway sausage and peppers rolls (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Peppers up to 1 day ahead, reheat

steps.text: Slice the capsicums and onions.
Fry in the oil over medium heat until soft and sweet, seasoning with salt and oregano.
Grill the vegetarian sausages, turning, then split lengthways.
Toast the long rolls.
Fill with sausage, pile on the peppers and onions and finish with mustard.

veg.n: George's eight-and-eight hot dogs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Onions up to 1 day ahead, reheat

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter until golden.
Heat the vegetarian frankfurts in simmering water.
Grill the frankfurts for colour.
Toast the hot dog buns, no more and no less.
Fill each with a frankfurt, the onions, a squeeze of mustard, a spoon of relish and grated cheddar.

veg.n: MacKenzie in-laws beetroot cured blinis
veg.make_ahead: Topping up to 4 hours ahead, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Toss the beetroot with the juice of one lemon, the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt and leave to cure.
Warm the blinis at 180C.
Mix the crème fraîche with lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Top each blini with the crème fraîche mix, a ribbon of beetroot, capers and a sliver of red onion.
Finish with a dill sprig and cracked pepper and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.n: Gettysburg training camp hoagies (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep wrapped and chilled

ingredients.item: roasted red capsicum from a jar

steps.text: Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano and pepper into a dressing.
Split the baguettes and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.
Layer with the eggplant, artichoke hearts, roasted capsicum and provolone.
Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and pickled peppers, then the rest of the dressing.
Press closed and wrap tightly.
Rest wrapped for 10 minutes.
Cut each baguette into pieces.

veg.n: Titans game day chilli dogs (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Dice the onions, keeping a handful aside for the top.
Brown the plant-based mince with most of the onion in the oil.
Add the cumin, paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water and simmer until thick.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts.
Toast the hot dog buns.
Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, scatter with grated cheddar and grill to melt.
Top with the reserved onion and mustard.

veg.n: Joliet steel mill lentil loaf sandwiches
veg.make_ahead: Meatloaf up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Grate the onion and fry with the mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the onion and mushrooms, egg, breadcrumbs, soy sauce and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Cool completely, then slice thickly.
Toast the bread and fill with the loaf, cheddar, pickles and tomato relish and cut in half.

veg.n: Notre Dame tailgate beer brats (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Simmer the vegetarian sausages in the lager with the onions and butter.
Lift out the sausages and grill, turning, until charred.
Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky.
Toast the rolls.
Fill with a sausage and a pile of beer onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.

veg_af.n: Notre Dame tailgate brats with sticky onions (vegetarian, alcohol-free)

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Simmer the vegetarian sausages in the stock, malt vinegar and brown sugar with the onions and butter.
Lift out the sausages and grill, turning, until charred.
Keep boiling the onions until the liquid reduces and they turn sticky.
Toast the rolls.
Fill with a sausage and a pile of sticky onions and finish with wholegrain mustard.

veg.n: Flemington Cup day party pies (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Dice the onion and brown with the plant-based mince in the oil.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, a good squeeze of tomato sauce, the soy sauce and plenty of pepper and simmer until thick.
Cool the filling.
Cut bases from the shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin.
Fill, top with rounds of puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Serve with tomato sauce.
